arStrings.szText: Becoming Crowd Controlled while you have {c_important}{u}Shadowform{/u}{/c} will consume a stack to apply it back to the attacker and adapt {c_important}{u}Shadowform{/u}{/c} to grant immunity to that type of effect for the next {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1|]{/c} seconds.
